checks.expected_result: Ca 4 buoc thuc hien tuan tu thanh cong; buoc (2) PUT di THANG len oe-cdn.sgp1.digitaloceanspaces.com, KHONG qua backend teeinblue

checks.title: Upload file khong hop le (sai dinh dang, qua kich thuoc) - hanh vi validate chua ro
checks.precondition: Dang o section Mockup, san sang upload
steps: Thu upload 1 file sai dinh dang (vd .txt, .pdf), quan sat ket qua/thong bao
Thu upload 1 file anh qua lon (vd >10MB, tuy gioi han thuc te), quan sat ket qua/thong bao
Xac dinh buoc nao chan (client validate truoc, presigned PUT tu choi, hay server sau khi upload xong)
checks.observation_point: Thong bao loi + buoc bi chan trong 4-buoc upload
checks.expected_result: CHUA XAC DINH - can dieu tra
checks.open_question: Khong co observed_validations nao cho luong upload mockup trong run CTX-20260910-04 (chi co 1 lan upload thanh cong voi file hop le 1024x768/17217 bytes). Hanh vi khi upload file sai dinh dang hoac qua kich thuoc hoan toan chua duoc test - buoc nao chan (client/presigned URL/server) chua ro.

checks.title: TTL, scope (bucket/prefix), gioi han kich thuoc file thuc te cua presigned upload URL
checks.precondition: Da co presigned URL tu buoc 1 cua luong upload
steps: Kiem tra TTL cua presigned URL (thu dung lai URL sau 1 khoang thoi gian)
Kiem tra scope cua URL (bucket/prefix co gioi han theo user/store khong)
Kiem tra gioi han kich thuoc file (thu upload file lon dan de tim nguong)
checks.observation_point: Ket qua thu lai/thu voi file kich thuoc khac nhau
checks.expected_result: CHUA XAC DINH - can dieu tra
checks.open_question: Response cua POST /api/users/{userId}/temporary-files/upload-url BI REDACT HOAN TOAN theo redaction policy (contract §6, chua header/field chua signature). TTL, scope (bucket/prefix), gioi han kich thuoc file KHONG the suy tu evidence da redact - day la dieu kien CONDITIONAL_PASS ro rang cua feature profile FEAT-06. Can PO/Dev/Backend cung cap thong tin qua kenh khac (docs/code review) thay vi co gang suy luan tu evidence da redact.

checks.title: Baseline: {userId} trong path buoc 1 dung users.id, KHONG phai staffs.id - route duy nhat co id nguoi dung trong path
checks.precondition: Dang thuc hien buoc 1 cua luong upload mockup
steps: Quan sat path cua POST /api/users/{userId}/temporary-files/upload-url
So sanh {userId} voi staffs.id (sub trong JWT) va users.id
checks.observation_point: Gia tri {userId} trong path so voi 2 loai id
checks.expected_result: BASELINE: {userId} = users.id (266), KHONG phai staffs.id (sub=273); day la route DUY NHAT trong toan bo capture co id nguoi dung nam trong path. Dung de theo doi neu id-scheme doi o cac run sau

checks.title: Co che thong bao hoan tat render mockup (polling/webhook) - CHUA quan sat duoc
steps: Cho toi khi render hoan tat (co the mat vai phut theo huong dan tren card)
Quan sat trong luc cho: co request polling dinh ky nao khong
Quan sat khi render xong: co websocket/push nao cap nhat UI tu dong khong, hay can reload thu cong
checks.observation_point: Network activity trong luc cho + cach UI cap nhat khi render xong
checks.expected_result: CHUA XAC DINH - can dieu tra
checks.open_question: Run nay khong cho toi khi render xong nen khong co evidence ve polling/webhook nao (portal-explorer dem polling=0 trong toan bo capture); chi co text huong dan 'reload after a few minutes'. Co che thuc su (polling dinh ky, webhook, hay hoan toan phai user tu reload) chua duoc xac nhan.
